claims: Italy defeated Northern Ireland 2-0 on March 26, 2026
The match was a UEFA World Cup playoff semi-final
The match took place in Bergamo, Italy
Sandro Tonali scored a goal at 56'
Moise Kean scored a goal at 80'
Sandro Tonali's goal and Moise Kean's goal were scored in the second half
Italy advanced to the playoff final against Bosnia and Herzegovina
Italy advances to the Path A UEFA World Cup playoff final
